preconditions.description: The number of queries t is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The order of the graph n is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
The vertices ai and bi in each query are between 1 and the number of vertices in graph D(n), inclusive, and they are not equal.
The vertices ai and bi in each query are less than or equal to 10^16.

postconditions.expression: The output contains t lines, each with a single integer representing the length of the shortest path between vertices ai and bi in graph D(n).
postconditions.description: For each query, the output must provide the length of the shortest path between the given vertices ai and bi in the graph D(n).
